# Nexow

> Nexow is an AI-native dashboard builder for financial markets. You describe a
> widget in plain language — a chart, table, heatmap or signal — and Nexow
> generates its source code with Anthropic's Claude, runs it in a sandboxed
> iframe, and streams live market data into it on a free-form canvas. It is
> private by default: in local mode, codegen runs in your browser with your own
> Anthropic API key and your widgets persist locally in IndexedDB.

## Key facts

- Category: AI-native dashboard / widget builder for trading and market data.
- How it works: prompt → AI-generated widget source → sandboxed iframe runtime → live data via connectors → refine in natural language.
- Privacy: private by default; bring-your-own-key codegen runs client-side; widgets, versions and logs stored in the browser (IndexedDB); many venues connect browser-direct.
- Connectors (20+): OANDA, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Deribit, BitMEX, Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Intrinio, IQFeed, Rithmic, LMAX, FXCM, Kalshi, Polymarket, Trading Economics, Postgres, ClickHouse, Qdrant.
- Markets covered: FX, crypto, equities, futures, options and prediction markets.
- AI model: Anthropic Claude via the Anthropic SDK.
- Pricing: preview is free; in private mode you pay only your own Anthropic API usage. Hosted plans (Pro, Teams) are planned.
- Status: public preview live. Roadmap: trading agents, server components, community.
- App: https://app.nexow.ai
